sents.en: Sorry, I have to clean the bathroom now.
sents.cn: 抱歉，我现在得打扫浴室。
blocks: Sorry, I have to clean the bathroom now.

sents.en: Mum, can I invite my friends to our new house?
sents.cn: 妈妈，我可以邀请朋友们来我们的新家吗？
blocks: Mum, can I invite my friends to our new house?

sents.en: Yes, but now we need to get ready for their arrival.
sents.cn: 是啊，不过现在我们得为他们的到来做准备。

sents.en: Well, it's not "grandma clean" yet!
sents.cn: 不过还没达到“奶奶标准的干净”！

sents.en: Dad, could you please give me a lift to the shop this afternoon?
sents.cn: 爸爸，今天下午你能载我去商店吗？
blocks: Dad, could you please give me a lift to the shop this afternoon?

sents.en: Helen, can I borrow your chess set?
sents.cn: 海伦，我能借下你的棋具吗？
blocks: Helen, can I borrow your chess set?

sents.en: Sorry, Jim, but you have to pack up your things first.
sents.cn: 抱歉，吉姆，你得先把东西打包好。

sents.en: Can I stay out until eleven?
sents.cn: 我可以在外面待到十一点吗？
blocks: Can I stay out until eleven?

sents.en: Can I go to the movies?
sents.cn: 我可以去看电影吗？
blocks: Can I go to the movies?

sents.en: Grandpa helped us pull the heavy luggage into the house.
sents.cn: 外公帮我们把沉重的行李拉进屋里。
blocks: Grandpa helped us pull the heavy luggage

sents.en: "Ah, home again!" said Mum with a smile on her face.
sents.cn: “啊，又回家了！”妈妈脸上带着微笑说。

sents.en: "Mm, the familiar taste of home!" said Mum.
sents.cn: “嗯，这就是熟悉的家的味道！”妈妈感慨道。
blocks: "Mm, the familiar taste of home!" said Mum.

sents.en: During the dinner, my uncle told us some jokes and we had a good laugh.
sents.cn: 吃饭的时候，舅舅还讲了几个笑话，把我们逗得哈哈大笑。
blocks: my uncle told us some jokes and we had a good laugh.

sents.en: Several days later when we were leaving, Grandma held my hands and asked us, "Will you come home more often?"
sents.cn: 几天后，我们准备离开时，外婆拉着我的手问我们：“你们会常回家看看吗？”
blocks: Several days later when we were leaving, Grandma held my hands and asked us, "Will you come home more often?"

sents.en: Mum nodded, with tears in her eyes.
sents.cn: 妈妈点了点头，眼中噙着泪水。

sents.en: Where did the writer go for the Spring Festival?
sents.cn: 作者在春节时去了哪里？
blocks: Where did the writer go for the Spring Festival?

sents.en: In the text, what words are used to describe people's feelings?
sents.cn: 文中用了哪些词汇描述人物的情感？
blocks: In the text, what words are used to describe people's feelings?

sents.en: Grandpa helped us pull our luggage into the house.
sents.cn: 外公帮我们把沉重的行李拉进屋里。
blocks: Grandpa helped us pull our luggage

sents.en: It was fun to decorate your room last month.
sents.cn: 上个月一起布置你的房间真的很有意思。
blocks: to decorate your room last month.

sents.en: There are cute animals on them, but the animals look too childish for us.
sents.cn: 上面有一些可爱的动物，但这些动物对我们来说太幼稚了。
blocks: There are cute animals on them,
but the animals look too childish for us.

sents.en: We want to cover the animals and paint the walls with warm colours.
sents.cn: 我们想把这些动物遮住，给墙壁涂上暖色调。
blocks: to cover the animals and paint the walls

sents.en: Wait until the elders are seated before taking your seat, and wait for them to start eating first.
sents.cn: 等长辈落座后再入座，在他们动筷后再开吃。
blocks: Wait until the elders are seated
before taking your seat, and wait for them

sents.en: Cover your mouth with your hand when using a toothpick.
sents.cn: 使用牙签时要用手遮住嘴巴。
